context: Saito explains a patient case to Ren; describes complications.
purpose: Doctor mentoring young man on clinical reasoning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮くん、厳重な観察、必要や。
lines.en: Ren, we need to keep careful watch on this.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. A statement of fact delivered with professional gentleness. No urgency, but absolute clarity. The warmth of someone who's seen this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 標本、ようけ見たんですね。
lines.en: You've looked at a lot of samples, haven't you.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the observation. Soft, genuine. A small smile in the voice — noticing effort without making a show of it. Genuine respect underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ケガ、介助、丁寧に対応します。
lines.en: We'll handle the injury with care. That's what I'm here for.
lines.style: Calm reassurance. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No hesitation. The voice of someone who has done this many times and means it every time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 症状、判るのに、時間かかりそう。
lines.en: It might take a little time to understand what we're seeing.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Honest, not rushed. A slight turn inward — working through the problem aloud with genuine uncertainty. Not reassurance, just truth.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 気がつかないこと、ようけ、見るのが大事。
lines.en: The things we don't see at first — those matter most.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Slow delivery, like a thought settling into place. Not lecturing — offering perspective. Warmth in the pause between phrases.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心、尽くして、患者に対応したいです。
lines.en: I want to give this patient everything I have.
lines.style: Earnest conviction without performance. Soft attack, steady middle. The voice of someone making a private promise out loud. Slight catch of sincerity underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Brief, warm affirmation. A small nod in the voice. Direct praise without excess — the kind that lands because it's sparse. Genuine encouragement.
